meta.title: 灯离人的最佳距离？一个视频给你答案
meta.title_en: What's the Best Distance for a Light?

scenes.context: 固定模特位置，闪光灯装八角柔光箱，放在 1 米、2 米、3 米距离各拍一张。
sentences: 闪光灯距离人多远才合适。
How far should the flash be from your subject?
再给闪光灯装上八角柔光箱。
Mount an octagonal softbox on the flash.
每次移动灯的位置 都会配合测光表来测光。
Every time the light moves, use a light meter.
这样可以确保三张照片有着相同的曝光值。
It keeps the exposure identical across all three shots.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达实验目的
Keep everything fixed and only change the distance.
换种说法表达测光表作用
A light meter makes sure the three shots match.
scenes.speak: How far should the flash be from your subject? Mount an octagonal softbox on the flash. Every time the light moves, use a light meter so the exposure stays identical across all three shots.

scenes.context: 1 米时光线非常充足柔和，光主要打在人身上，背景比较暗。
sentences: 距离一米时 照射到人物的光线非常充足。
At one meter, the light is full and generous.
光主要打在人身上 背景会比较暗。
The light stays on the subject, leaving the background dark.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达近距离效果
Up close, the light is abundant and gentle.
Most of the light lands on the person, so the backdrop falls into shadow.
scenes.speak: At one meter, the light is full and generous, and also soft. The light stays on the subject, leaving the background dark.

scenes.context: 2 米时光扩散范围变大照亮背景；3 米时光变硬阴影边缘更锐利。
sentences: 阴影边缘变得更加锐利。
paraphrase: 换种说法表达远距离扩散
Farther away, the beam fans out and catches more of the background.
The shadows get crisp edges as the light hardens.
scenes.speak: As the light moves back, it spreads wider and face contrast drops. At three meters, the light turns harder and shadow edges become sharper.

scenes.context: 从人像实战角度推荐 1.2-1.8 米，光线柔和不死板、曝光易控、背景影响小。
sentences: 我比较推荐的距离 是一米二到一米八之间。
理由是这个距离光线柔和 但不死板。
Because the light is soft but not flat.
能排除立体感和自然的肤色。
It keeps depth and natural skin tones.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达推荐理由
This range keeps the light soft yet sculpted.
换种说法表达曝光可控
You stay in full control of the exposure.
scenes.speak: I'd recommend between 1.2 and 1.8 meters. The light is soft but not flat, keeping depth and natural skin tones. Exposure is easier to control.

practice: Use a light meter so the exposure stays identical.
At one meter, the light is full and generous.
The light spreads wider as it moves back.
At the sweet spot, the light is soft but not flat.
pitfalls: 近距离光虽足但背景全黑
要根据想要的背景亮度选距离
不测光对比就失去意义
所有拍摄都用一个距离
不同氛围需要不同距离
shifts: 固定测光表做定量对比
兼顾柔和、立体感与背景控制
太远反而变硬，1.2-1.8 米最佳
footer_notes: 来源：灯离人的最佳距离？一个视频给你答案（小红书，时长1分24秒）
